meta.name: game-qa
meta.description: Verify a game with evidence on its selected target runtime. Launch the actual build and prove real rendering, input, the core loop, at least one designed outcome, restart, and explicit limitations without dressing subjective fun up as a certain verdict. Use for test a generated game, QA a game build, check whether the game is fully playable, or verify the build. 游戏证据化质量验证。在选定的目标运行环境中启动实际构建，证明真实渲染、输入、核心循环、至少一个设计结果、重开和明确限制，不把主观趣味包装成确定性结论。用于测试生成游戏、检查游戏能否完整游玩或验证构建。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 启动游戏实机验证，用证据证明渲染、操作、核心循环和重开都真实可用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你生成或构建了一个游戏，想在交给玩家前确认它真能完整运行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify a game build actually runs end-to-end before release

howto.what: 装上后，当你要测试游戏时，它会实际启动游戏构建，验证渲染、输入、核心循环、设计结果和重开，输出通过/失败报告，不评判趣味。
howto.when: 当你说要测试一个生成游戏、检查游戏能否完整游玩，或验证游戏构建时触发。

say.text: 测试这个游戏，确认它能启动、操作并能完整玩完。
say.note: 它会启动构建并验证六项必需检查，输出 PASS/FAIL。

say.text: 验证这个游戏构建，给出运行证据，并指出不能玩的地方。
say.note: 它会检查核心循环和重开，把问题列为 limitation。

say.text: 检查这个游戏在目标设备上能不能玩，给出结论。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you ask to test a game, it will actually launch the game build, verify rendering, input, core loop, designed outcome, and restart, and output a pass/fail report without judging fun.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say you want to test a generated game, check whether the game is fully playable, or verify a game build.

say_en.text: Test this game: confirm launch, input, and full playthrough.
say_en.note: It runs the build and checks all six required items.

say_en.text: Verify this game build, provide runtime evidence, and point out what blocks play.
say_en.note: It records limitations and maps failures to core checks.

say_en.text: Check if this game runs on the target device and give a verdict.
say_en.note: The result is NOT_RUN, FAIL, or PASS, not a fun rating.
